scoring_justification: Recompute adsorption energies from agent's provided total energies and compare to paper-reported values with tolerance; structural thresholds and charge transfers also checked. T1 is feasible because the raw total energies are submitted and the formula is deterministic.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported gold values for adsorption energies, charge transfers, and structural thresholds
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper abstract and conclusion: adsorption energies of H2, CH4, C2H2 on pristine Ti2N (Table/Figure 5,6); charge transfers and H-H distance from the same sections; C-C elongation > 1.2 Å derived from reported stretch of 0.232 Å over initial C≡C length.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from published values in the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All numbers match the published values in the paper; the reference oracle writes total energies that recompute exactly to these gold values, confirming consistency.

outputs.description: Final reproduction results containing the raw total energies and derived properties. The checker will recompute adsorption energies as E_ad = total_energies['h2_ti2n'] − total_energies['h2'] − total_energies['ti2n'] (and analogously for CH4, C2H2) and compare each recomputed value to the hidden paper-reported adsorption energy with a tolerance. Structural requirements and charge transfers are also checked.

output_contract.notes: The output_contract defines the machine-readable scoring interface. All values are as computed by the agent; no hidden gold values or tolerances are exposed.

steps.description: Recompute H2 adsorption energy from total_energies and compare to paper-reported gold with tolerance.
Recompute CH4 adsorption energy from total_energies and compare to paper-reported gold with tolerance.
Recompute C2H2 adsorption energy from total_energies and compare to paper-reported gold with tolerance.
Verify structural requirements: |E_ad(H2)| > 2.0 eV, |E_ad(C2H2)| > 4.0 eV, |E_ad(CH4)| < 0.5 eV, H2_HH > 2.5 Å, C2H2_CC > 1.2 Å. Pass/fail for each sub-check; score is fraction of sub-checks passed.
Verify Hirshfeld charge transfers within ±0.03 e of paper-reported values.
